title: Money 24 Home
paperNote: The desk's own book. No real money is held or moved.
offline: The runner isn't running. Start the desktop app, or run m24d.

positions.title: Open positions
positions.empty: Nothing is running on the desk right now.
positions.modelNote: Worked out from the stock's candles, not from traded prices.

wallet.title: account
wallet.note: Starting capital {capital} plus closed trades. Not real money.
wallet.flat: No closed trades in this range.
wallet.unknown: The account can't be read while the runner is offline.
wallet.cashNote: A cash account: no margin, no borrowing. A buy needs settled cash. Coin sales settle at once; stock and option sales the next business day.

day.label: Today on the calendar
day.open: Show today's playbook and the week ahead
day.unknown: The calendar comes from the runner.

desk.title: The desk
desk.scoutPlan: entry {entry} by {by} · stop {stop} · targets {t1} / {t2} · out by {out} ({hold}m)
desk.scoutStatNote: Every play the scout finds is followed to its stop, first target or time exit, traded or not.

predict.head: {venue} · live prices · paper
predict.account: cash {cash} · in play {open}, bids {mark} · settled {realized} · {won} of {settled} won
predict.bandStat: {watched} followed · {settled} settled · {won}% won · needs {needs}% · {edge} a dollar
predict.bandWaiting: {watched} followed · waiting for the first results
predict.bandNote: Every favorite the rule finds is followed to its result, traded or not, as if one contract were bought at its price with Kalshi's fee. Needs: the win rate that breaks even.
predict.empty: Nothing bought yet. The desk looks at Kalshi every {every} minutes, around the clock, for favorites at {min}–{max}¢ closing within {hours} hours.

desk.scoutEmpty: Nothing found yet. The scout looks every minute of the stock session.
desk.brokerNote: Every desk trade is also placed at the broker, so its real fills can be set beside the desk's own prices.
desk.brokerSlip: How much worse the broker's fill was than the desk's price. Green: better.
desk.brokerEmpty: No broker orders yet. Each desk trade appears here with the broker's fill.
desk.brokerNone: No broker connected. Add Alpaca keys to .env and restart.
desk.voided: Dropped {name}: no price to close it at
desk.empty: Nothing yet. The desk writes every buy, sale and refusal here as it happens.
desk.scanEmpty: No scan yet. The first one runs a few seconds after the runner starts.
desk.scanOld: This runner has no desks. Update and restart it.

news.title: Headlines
news.offline: The news service isn't running. Start the desktop app, or run newsd.
